description: Send a new message to a Chat channel (ClickUp Chat v3). Optionally assign it (turning it into an actionable item) and choose message vs. post type. Returns the created message with its id.

assignee.description: User id to assign the message to, making it an action item for them.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel to post in.

content.description: Message body text. Format is set by `content_format`.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

type.description: 'message' for a normal chat message, 'post' for a rich post. Defaults to 'message'.

name: send_chat_message
